business_overview.one_sentence: Fenbi provides PRC non-formal vocational education and training, mainly tutoring services, plus books and other sales.

segments.business_substance: Offline classroom-based and online tutoring courses, membership packages and challenge exercises.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Segment information, PDF pages 152-153

segments.business_substance: Textbooks, learning materials, related printing business and health goods.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Segment information, PDF pages 152-153

business_overview.revenue_model: Tutoring revenue is recognized over time; book and other goods revenue is recognized when goods are delivered. Course fees are typically paid in advance before courses begin.
business_notes: 2025 revenue declined 4.1% due to low-price competition in recruitment examination tutoring.
Substantially all external customer revenue is generated in the PRC.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash employee compensation excluded by company from adjusted net profit, but economically dilutive compensation.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, Non-IFRS reconciliation, PDF page 13; Note 9, PDF page 158

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value gains on financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Treasury investment fair value gain, not tutoring operating profit.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, Note 7 and Note 20, PDF pages 156 and 172

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank deposits on demand and cash at licensed payment institutions; currencies include RMB, USD and HKD.
Restricted cash; not available for ordinary detachable cash pool.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Balance sheet and Note 31, PDF pages 127 and 186

funds_assets.item: Term deposits with initial term over three months
funds_assets.business_substance: USD current term deposits of RMB166.055m and RMB non-current term deposits of RMB200.099m.

funds_assets.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
funds_assets.business_substance: Wealth management products, mostly non-guaranteed variable or fixed return products.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Financial Review and Note 20, PDF pages 14 and 172

funds_assets.item: Other financial assets at amortised cost
funds_assets.business_substance: Short-term note and other investments with guaranteed annual return, held for contractual principal and interest.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Financial Review and Note 21, PDF pages 15-16 and 172

financing_liabilities.business_substance: No outstanding bank loans or other borrowings at 2025 year-end.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, Borrowings and gearing ratio, PDF page 18

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Lease liabilities for continuing office/offline tutoring premises; treated as operating lease burden in owner earnback analysis rather than cash debt deduction.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, Balance sheet and Note 31, PDF pages 127 and 186-187
